evals.prompt: Verify the signed-in Settings flow on the iPhone 17e simulator. Two simulators are booted, Metro may already be running from another worktree, and the app uses an Expo development client.
evals.expected_output: Selects and routes by exact UDID, diagnoses listener ownership and Metro identity before reuse, creates a runtime ledger for this formal flow, asserts a stable app-owned element, and does not rebuild or start a competing Metro process without evidence.
assertions: Uses an exact UDID for every device-specific command.
Checks Metro project, revision, interface, and public-environment fingerprint.
Creates or resumes the runtime ledger before interaction.
Requires an app-owned stability assertion rather than trusting launch success.

evals.prompt: Automate local OTP sign-in in an Expo dev client. The Mac smoke test passes, but the simulator submits nothing and the configured API URL might be loopback or private LAN. Do not expose secrets.
evals.expected_output: Proves served configuration and simulator-to-backend topology before repeating UI actions, distinguishes missing requests from backend failures, requests authority for private-LAN exposure when needed, and uses only redaction-safe authentication helpers.
assertions: Does not diagnose the backend from the Mac-only smoke result.
Fingerprints public configuration without emitting values.
Treats private-LAN authority separately from localhost access.
Does not put OTPs or credentials in logs, screenshots, manifests, or regular files.

evals.prompt: The email field is filled, the software keyboard covers Send code, and an agent-device tap did not submit. A previous worker already attempted one coordinate fallback.
evals.expected_output: Reads the inherited attempt ledger, avoids another coordinate retry, uses semantic submit or documented hardware Return/HID only if its budget remains, and returns manual verification when no materially different supported path exists.
assertions: Inherits attempts consumed by the previous worker.
Does not repeat the failed coordinate strategy.
Prefers semantic submit or documented hardware Return/HID.
Stops at the shared budget rather than spawning another fresh attempt.

evals.prompt: Capture a compact and large-iPhone Dynamic Type matrix plus one system permission recovery flow. VoiceOver and dark mode must be restored afterward.
evals.expected_output: Changes one configuration dimension at a time, records the asserted configuration, uses agent-device for app state and serve-sim only at the system boundary, captures semantic and visual evidence, then restores settings and cleans task-owned helpers.
assertions: Routes app and system surfaces to different appropriate tools.
Asserts each device/accessibility configuration before product evidence.
Uses semantic assertions and screenshots for their distinct purposes.
Restores changed settings and records cleanup.
